name: Kingdom of Mangareva (until 1844)
description: A white field with a blue horizontal stripe across the centre bearing a white star, and four blue stars in the corners.
history: Attributed to the explorer Dumont d'Urville and adopted around 1837 (the design is dated 1832 in some accounts) by the Mangarevan kingdom converted by the Picpus missionaries. It was replaced by the French tricolour when the protectorate was established in 1844.

features.symbolism: the four high islands of the Gambier group
